name: Rakh Bagh Temple
town_description: Ludhiana is Punjab's largest industrial city on the Grand Trunk Road. Rakh Bagh is a large central public park on Club Road, opposite Guru Nanak Stadium, used for morning walks, family outings, a toy train and rides - a leisure spot rather than a known pilgrimage destination.

travel.airport: Sahnewal Airport (Ludhiana) has limited service (verify); nearest major airport is Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport, Amritsar (~135 km) or Chandigarh (~100 km).
travel.railway: Ludhiana Junction on the Delhi-Amritsar line; Rakh Bagh is in central Ludhiana, a short auto/taxi ride away.
travel.road: Club Road is central Ludhiana, easily reached by autos, taxis and city buses.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published for a temple under this name (verify existence locally). Rakh Bagh park itself is open mornings and evenings for walkers (verify timings).
